decisions.reason: It remains a strong fit with the firm's established psychiatric and psychosomatic care and its dedicated presentation suggests continuing strategic support.
The workshop still fits the firm's therapeutic and vocational capabilities, but its custom-furniture business remains more peripheral and commercially exposed than core care services.
Senior-living counseling is closely tied to the firm's eldercare focus and its prominent placement indicates that management likely sees it as part of the core offer.
Meal delivery for seniors complements outpatient and everyday-life support well, though as a newer and less prominently presented service it carries moderate execution and demand risk.
